<!-- Generated by tools/engine_docs.py from the engine's OpenAPI description. Do not edit. -->

| Method | Path | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/v1/info` | Engine version, dependency versions, devices and limits. |
| GET | `/api/v1/filters` | The catalog entries that run in this engine, and whether this engine can run them. |
| GET | `/api/v1/filters/{filter_id}` | One catalog entry, and whether this engine can run it. |
| POST | `/api/v1/filters/{filter_id}/representation` | The operator for the Inspector, built by the same code that runs the filter. |
| GET | `/api/v1/models` | The optional models, with their license and whether they are downloaded. |
| GET | `/api/v1/models/{model_id}` | One model, with the progress of a download that runs. |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/models/{model_id}` | Remove a downloaded model and its files. |
| GET | `/api/v1/models/{model_id}/tensors` | The input and output tensors of a downloaded model, read from its ONNX files. |
| POST | `/api/v1/models/{model_id}/download` | Start downloading one model on the user's request. Every file is checked against its SHA-256. Ask GET /models/{id} for the progress. |
| POST | `/api/v1/images` | Upload raw RGBA bytes once. The content hash is the image id. |
| GET | `/api/v1/images/{image_id}/metadata` | The id, size and channel count of an uploaded image. |
| POST | `/api/v1/ai/{task_id}` | Run an AI task with an engine model, for the AI router's engine model provider. The result is a job: a mask as a gray image, or an image. |
| POST | `/api/v1/jobs` | Start a filter job on an uploaded image. Parameters are checked against the catalog. |
| GET | `/api/v1/jobs/{job_id}` | The state and progress of a job. |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/jobs/{job_id}` | Cancel a job and stop its process. |
| GET | `/api/v1/jobs/{job_id}/events` | Server-sent events with the job status, until the job ends. |
| GET | `/api/v1/jobs/{job_id}/result` | The result image as raw RGBA with X-Width and X-Height, or JSON for tables. |
